name: GRAYSON SAUNA
description: The Grayson Sauna is an easy-to-assemble indoor sauna designed to turn any part of your home into a personal paradise. Created to take up a small footprint and handcrafted with top-tier materials, the Grayson blends efficiency with beauty. This sauna will heat up in as little as 30 minutes, so you can enjoy your Grayson whenever inspiration strikes.
